name: True Focus
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only (no React Bits source read): a dependency-free word-by-word focus pull with a gliding corner frame, useful for hero taglines and section headings.

blur.description: Blur on the words out of focus, in px.

dim.description: Opacity of the words out of focus.

pause.description: Time each word holds focus before the next pull, in ms.

glowColor.description: Colour of the glow around the frame.

frame.description: Draw the corner-bracket frame around the focused word.

manual.description: Hover drives the focus instead of the timer; the resting state is fully sharp.

a11y: The original child nodes move unchanged into a visually hidden span, so screen readers read the text once with its inline markup; the split word copy and the frame are aria-hidden.
The host keeps its element, heading level and role; no aria-label or tabindex is added.
With manual set, the resting state is fully sharp, so keyboard and touch users who never hover see every word clearly.
Reduced motion and forced-colors mode remove the blur and dimming entirely, and reduced motion also hides the frame and stops the timer.
